messages:
maria: Quick sync: drafting a Legal Hold for enterprise customers that creates a tamper-evident evidence export. Need product + ops scope.
kevin: top-level flow?
maria: 1) tenant sets legal_hold with metadata 2) events marked preserved (skip TTL) 3) optional cold-archive but cannot be deleted 4) on-demand export produces signed bundle 5) revoke resumes deletes.
anya: cost question 1: do we keep hot forever?
maria: default hot-preserve 30d then cold-archive but retained. Provide hot-only flag for short holds.
leo: ops: global TTL override touches archiver and retention-index; historical backfill risk. Need migration plan.
jordan: compliance needs chain-of-custody: signed manifest, monotonic seq, region-normalized timestamps.
legal-bot: PRD created with manifest schema draft.
kevin: GA decision: require BYOK parity for enterprise exports; self-serve gets documented escrow.
anya: acceptance tests: TTL skipped while active; export includes event range; signature verifies; revoke resumes deletes; cost alert when preserved > threshold.
leo: emergency-unset: require 2-person SRE approval + audit log entry.
maria: rollout: internal alpha, 2 pilot customers, GA after BYOK parity + runbook.
kevin: I'll write tech spec and invite eng-sre.
maria: updating PRD and UX mocks. Kickoff Friday. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder to attach regulatory citations to PRD.
kevin: end.
